# Module map

Every export in `public/` and `src/` (excluding `public/vendor/` and `*.generated.ts`), classified by REACHABILITY -- not just "does anything import this", which cannot distinguish real usage from a demo page nothing else loads. Read this before proposing to build a capability -- `docs/AUDIT-PROTOCOL.md`'s nine recorded pattern-E failures all shipped work beside a capability nobody checked already existed.

**PRODUCT** (no marker below) is reachable from wrangler.jsonc's `"main"` or the module scripts in `public/index.html`/`public/city.html` -- what a visitor's browser or the Worker itself actually runs. **DEMO-ONLY** has a real caller, but that caller is only ever reached from one of the OTHER html pages in `public/` -- roadkit.js's `junction` and `roundabout` are this shape: called from `public/roadkit-street-demo.js`, which nothing else imports. **TEST-ONLY** is reachable only from `test/`. **UNREACHABLE** has no caller reachable from anywhere. See `test/deadExports.allowlist.json`'s own header for the full reasoning, and `test/deadExports.test.ts` (the gate this map shares its data with).
